## Change

Describe what changed, why, and the intended target branch.

## Verification

List the tests, checks, or manual verification performed. Include any gaps.

## Release impact

Describe impact on staging, the public demo, security, or data. For a stable release,
link the reviewed staging CI run and document the rollback path.

- [ ] The PR contains only the intended changes.
- [ ] Secrets and private configuration are outside the diff.
